releases.notes:
**Brutal Typing** is the Minecraft take on the *Ridiculous Coding* / *Power Mode* VS Code extensions — every keystroke in chat and text fields detonates, and the faster you type, the more brutal it gets.

> ⚠️ **Beta** — client-side only, purely for fun. Please report anything that crashes or feels off.

### Pick the jar for your Minecraft version

| Jar | Minecraft (Fabric) |
|---|---|
| `brutaltyping-1.0.0-beta.1+mc1.21.1.jar` | 1.21 – 1.21.1 |
| `brutaltyping-1.0.0-beta.1+mc1.21.3.jar` | 1.21.2 – 1.21.3 |
| `brutaltyping-1.0.0-beta.1+mc1.21.4.jar` | 1.21.4 |
| `brutaltyping-1.0.0-beta.1+mc1.21.5.jar` | 1.21.5 |
| `brutaltyping-1.0.0-beta.1+mc1.21.8.jar` | 1.21.6 – 1.21.8 |
| `brutaltyping-1.0.0-beta.1+mc1.21.10.jar` | 1.21.9 – 1.21.10 |
| `brutaltyping-1.0.0-beta.1+mc1.21.11.jar` | 1.21.11 |
| `brutaltyping-1.0.0-beta.1+mc26.1.2.jar` | 26.1.x |

### Requirements
- **Fabric API**
- **Mod Menu** (optional, for the settings GUI)

### Install
Drop the jar matching your Minecraft version into your `mods/` folder alongside Fabric API (and Mod Menu).

### Highlights
- Explosions, fire, soul fire, brutal flying letters, screen shake & explosion sounds on every keystroke
- An **amplifier** that heats up the faster you type: `COLD → WARM → HOT → BRUTAL → INFERNO → APOCALYPSE`
- **ALL-CAPS importance**, spacebar **impact frames**, falling **weapon drops**, and a **send-slam** animation
- Varied delete sounds, crit stars, enchant sparkles, milestone fireworks
- Tabbed settings GUI (Mod Menu or a keybind) with a live "try it here" box

Configure via **Mod Menu → Brutal Typing**, or bind a key under **Options → Controls → Brutal Typing**.

Inspired by [Ridiculous Coding](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=Merenut.ridiculous-coding) and [Power Mode](https://github.com/hoovercj/vscode-power-mode).
